text:
maria_cs: FYI — VantageMed People Ops reached out this morning. They want to pilot embeddings + a small chat assistant for HR and Ops teams. Looks like 3 new teams (HR, Payroll, Facilities) and a projected burst of ~180 qps during business hours.

derek_ae: Nice. Any signals this is tied to renewal or upsell?

maria_cs: Yes — renewal conversation in 6 weeks. Customer said successful pilot will tip them to expand across 8 more squads. If we miss latency/cost targets, risk goes up.

olivia_solutions: Can we run a short enablement / kickoff next Tue? I can do a 30m call to cover integration, best prompts, and monitoring. @derek_ae do you want to join?

derek_ae: I'll join. Also need a concise playbook for them — onboarding checklist + who to ping for infra issues.

kevin_engineer: From infra side: current shared pool should handle steady-state, but 180 qps bursts mean we should either pre-warm dedicated slots or configure autoscale policies. Can we get expected token lengths and concurrency distribution?

sanjay_se: Customer mentioned mostly short embeddings requests (avg 600 tokens for context) and chat messages ~40 tokens. They want summaries of policy docs and quick people-ops lookups. Also flagged concern about PHI in some HR notes — data residency question.

maria_cs: Sanjay — add: they use EU-only data centers for payroll. Need private deployment or VPC for that dataset. I'll capture in the CS ticket.

onboard-bot: Created onboarding playbook: https://redwood.internal/onboard/vantagemed-1712349876 (private link)

olivia_solutions: Quick note for the playbook: recommend embeddings quantization profiles for cost, and enable prefix caching for the policy doc use-case. Add a short prompt template for policy-summarize with citation ask.

kevin_engineer: Ops note: sample autoscale policy we can offer in the kickoff:

```
scale_policy: {
  target_qps: 150,
  burst_capacity: 250,
  prewarm_minutes: 30,
  fallback_model: "smaller-embed-v2"
}
```

kevin_engineer: I'll drop that into the playbook. Also tagging infra_sre for capacity verify.

infra_sre: Checked baseline — current Dedicated pools in us-central can absorb initial ramp but EU private will need a small dedicated pod (2x A100 equivalent) to meet SLOs. ETA for provisioning ~5 business days.

sanjay_se: One more: they reported hallucination on a previous policy summarization test — we should add a QA prompt set and a regression alert tied to those prompts before rollout.

maria_cs: Good call. I'll coordinate with Product to wire a regression alert and capture initial eval prompts. Derek — I'll add the renewal note to your pipeline: pilot success = high chance of orgwide expansion.

derek_ae: Thanks. Can someone create a brief customer-facing one-pager for the kickoff (what we'll measure, who's involved, timeline)? Need before Tue.

olivia_solutions: I'll draft it and post here for review by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Awesome. I'll open a renewal watch tag and flag for CSM + AE touchpoints weekly until decision.

kevin_engineer: I'll queue the EU pod request once we finalize expected qps window.

maria_cs: Closing loop: onboard-bot ticket #8421 created, playbook link above, kickoff Tue at 10am. Thanks team.

onboard-bot: Ticket #8421 status: open -> onboarding_scheduled (kickoff 2024-05-07T10:00:00Z)
